evals.prompt: I've just been put on the [Client] site upgrade — moving it from Umbraco 13 to v17. Where do I start? This is a fairly standard Etch CMS site, nothing too custom. I have a fresh checkout of main on my machine.
evals.expected_output: Walks through the canonical sequence: pre-flight (run fix-visible-property.ps1 on v13 side, branch off main, package audit), then backend retarget, then ModelsBuilder rebuild + full uSync export, then DB/content migration (with the UDI→GUID transform and republish workaround), then backoffice/frontend, then verify. Should route to specific sub-skills for each stage rather than trying to explain everything inline. Should emphasise doing the v13-side visible-property fix BEFORE upgrading.
expectations: Mentions running fix-visible-property.ps1 on the v13 side BEFORE branching or upgrading
Mentions creating a feature/v17 branch off main as part of pre-flight
Mentions package audit as a pre-flight step
Names or routes to umbraco-13-to-17-backend for the backend retarget step
Names or routes to umbraco-13-to-17-db-content for the DB/content migration step
Names or routes to umbraco-13-to-17-backoffice-frontend for the backoffice/frontend step
States that uSync export should happen AFTER the site compiles and boots (not before)
Presents the canonical upgrade order: pre-flight → backend → models+uSync export → DB/content → backoffice/frontend → verify

evals.prompt: I'm part way through the v17 upgrade. The site compiles now and boots, but content is rendering weirdly — homepage looks almost right at first then breaks. Also some blocks are showing as hidden that shouldn't be. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: Recognises this is mid-upgrade and should NOT restart from the beginning. Identifies two distinct symptoms: the content-rendering bug (workaround: delete home node + uSync re-import to force republish) and the visible-state bug (which needs the v13-side fix script, ideally before upgrade — if missed, options are manual toggle, rollback, or write a v17-side equivalent). Routes to umbraco-13-to-17-db-content for the detail.
expectations: Does NOT restart from Step 0 or re-walk the full upgrade sequence from scratch
Identifies the content-rendering bug (homepage breaks) and recommends the force-republish workaround (delete home node + uSync re-import)
Identifies the visible-state bug (blocks showing as hidden) as a separate issue from the rendering bug
Mentions fix-visible-property.ps1 in the context of the visible-state bug and notes it should have been run on v13 before upgrading
Routes to umbraco-13-to-17-db-content for the detailed fix steps

evals.prompt: We're planning the Umbraco upgrade for next sprint. Can you give me a rough sense of how the work splits up so I can estimate it? The site is Etch.Cms-based, currently on v13, target is v17.
evals.expected_output: Describes the three-track split: backend (csproj retarget to net10, packages, Program.cs, ModelsBuilder, RazorSourceGenerator fix), backoffice/frontend (tag helper rename, SCSS, RTE/TipTap config, BlockPreview, CSP), and DB/content (uSync export-fix-import dance with two PowerShell scripts, force-republish workaround, master template ordering trick). Mentions that step ordering matters (e.g. uSync export only after the site compiles and boots). Useful for estimation.
expectations: Describes three distinct tracks: backend, backoffice/frontend, and DB/content
Backend track includes: .csproj retarget to net10.0, package updates, Program.cs changes, ModelsBuilder fix, and RazorSourceGenerator fix
Backoffice/frontend track includes: tag helper rename (our-X to etch-cms-X), SCSS changes, RTE/TipTap config, BlockPreview, and CSP
DB/content track includes: uSync export-fix-import dance with PowerShell scripts and the force-republish workaround
States that step ordering matters — specifically that uSync export only happens after site compiles and boots

evals.prompt: Quick question — for the v13 to v17 upgrade, can I just create the feature branch off main and start updating packages, or is there prep work I need to do first?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces the pre-flight work as critical: run fix-visible-property.ps1 on v13 main FIRST (before touching the upgrade branch), do a package audit to identify anything without v17 availability, then branch. Explains why the visible-property fix specifically must happen pre-upgrade (rolling back later is painful). Points to the pre-flight-checklist.md reference.
expectations: Explicitly states that fix-visible-property.ps1 must be run BEFORE branching (on v13 main, not the upgrade branch)
Mentions package audit as required pre-flight work before starting the upgrade
Explains why the visible-property fix must happen pre-upgrade (painful or risky to backtrack to it later)
References pre-flight-checklist.md as the source for the full pre-flight list

evals.prompt: Done with the Umbraco upgrade — site builds, boots, all the content seems to migrate fine, RTE looks good. About to merge feature/v17 to main. Anything I should double-check before doing that?
evals.expected_output: Walks through the done-checklist concerns: build is clean with no RazorSourceGenerator warnings, all CS8785 warnings cleared, content visibility states correct, MNTP filter properties resolving, templates appearing (no fall-through to 404), backoffice info partials rendering, no remaining <our-X> tags, GetDictionaryValue replaced with GetDictionaryValueOrDefault, BlockPreview disabled for BlockList, CSP console-clean, YouTube embeds work in backoffice, Forms submit end-to-end. Points to done-checklist.md.

Mentions CS8785 RazorSourceGenerator hintName warnings must all be clear before merging
Mentions content visibility states must be verified (blocks/nodes correctly shown or hidden)
Mentions MNTP filter properties resolving correctly (UDI to GUID transform worked)
Mentions <our-X> tags — all migrated to <etch-cms-X> or none remaining
